data.name: Alchemical Coal (Choking Smoke)
data.description: A kobold who chews and swallows this alchemically treated piece of coal (a full-round action) can make one breath weapon attack during the next minute. If the kobold fails to make a breath attack before this minute expires, it is sickened for 1 hour. This crumbling chunk of chalky white coal allows a kobold to breathe a 15-foot cone of foul vapor that deals 1d6 points of acid damage and sickens a creature for 1d4 rounds. A creature that succeeds at a DC 15 Reflex saving throw takes half damage and is not sickened. Other humanoid creatures that eat alchemical coal are sickened for 1 hour. Creatures that are immune to poison are immune to the sickened effect.
